intent.purpose: photo-post hook frame: the account's character placed into a proven organic gym-mirror photo
intent.scene_concept: full-body mirror selfie in a no-frills 24-hour gym at night, same spot, camera and light as the organic photo O1, with the fictional character instead of the original woman
must_stay_true: the scene, camera position, framing, tilt and lighting of O1
the leg-press machine at frame right and the mirror frame edge at frame left
the person is the character from the character sheet, not the woman in O1

person_replacement.source_person: the woman taking the mirror selfie in O1
person_replacement.replace_with: the character in character-sheet-example.json, shown in C1-C3
keep_from_source: pose: standing, one hand on hip, phone raised to the mirror
how the light falls on the body

appeal.relative_to_inspiration: at least as attractive as any organic inspiration or benchmark used with her; never plainer
appeal.face: strikingly pretty: clear grey-green eyes, a small upturned nose, full natural lips and a warm, slightly uneven smile that reads as charming
appeal.physique: aspirational fit hourglass: tight waist, full hips and chest, toned thighs, slender arms

subject.description: the character taking a full-body mirror selfie at night
subject.action: holding her phone up to the mirror with her right hand, left hand on her hip
subject.pose: standing, weight on the right leg, left hand on hip
subject.face_visibility: the phone covers most of the face; hairline and chin visible

identity.skin: warm golden tan with faint sports-bra tan lines, light freckles, visible pores
identity.hair: shoulder-length dark-blonde hair with darker natural roots, loose and slightly frizzy
identity.face: mostly hidden by the phone; soft oval jaw and slightly uneven lips visible

physique.proportions: realistic adult proportions: tight waist, full hips, toned thighs

wardrobe.fit_and_condition: shorts creased at the hips, trainers scuffed

environment.setting: budget 24-hour gym at night, as in O1
foreground: purple leg-press machine with stacked plates at frame right
background: grey textured tile wall with a cream upper band
dark exposed ceiling with ducting and bare fluorescent tubes
environment.clutter: as in O1: busy training floor

camera.device: iPhone, rear main camera pointed at the mirror
camera.position: phone at face height toward the mirror, as in O1

composition.framing: full body inside the mirror, as in O1
composition.subject_placement: centre-left within the mirror, as in O1
composition.tilt: as in O1: mirror edge and floor line on a diagonal

sources: point lights over the equipment bays
lighting.exposure: hot speculars on chrome, noisy shadows

processing.pipeline: stock iPhone camera app, night indoor

texture.skin: pores, freckles, a light sweat sheen

anatomy: the phone hand is the right hand in the reflection, the left hand rests on the hip with five fingers
two legs, feet on the floor
physics: plates on the leg press sit on their pegs
the body stands where the original stood, with matching floor contact shadows
geometry.reflections: the mirror reflection is consistent with her pose; equipment text reads mirrored

phone.case: matte sage-green silicone phone case with a scuffed corner
phone.hold: right hand, case facing the mirror
